about.intro_content: Prof. Zhi-Zhong Pan is Professor and Director of the Department of Colorectal Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, and Chairman of China's Colorectal Cancer MDT Alliance.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Pan has extensive experience in laparoscopic surgery, transanal minimally invasive surgery (TEM), comprehensive treatment of colorectal liver metastases, and stromal tumour treatment. He has published more than 60 papers in leading journals including the Journal of the National Cancer Institute and Annals of Oncology, and directs the Chinese Doctor's Association of Laparoscopic Surgeon Training Base. His research focuses on translational and clinical studies of colorectal cancer with liver metastasis, and he has championed standardisation of laparoscopic colorectal cancer surgery across China.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Zhi-Zhong Pan

items.question: Does Prof. Zhi-Zhong Pan accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to colorectal cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Pan's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Pan specialises in laparoscopic and minimally invasive surgery for colorectal cancer, including comprehensive treatment of colorectal liver metastases and stromal tumours.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Pan treat colorectal cancer with liver metastasis?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Pan's research and clinical practice have a strong focus on translational and clinical management of colorectal cancer with liver metastasis.

items.question: Is Prof. Pan involved in clinical trials for colorectal cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Pan led a randomised phase III multicentre trial on intraoperative chemotherapy for colorectal cancer patients undergoing curative resection.
